cases.about: A Word file becomes a PDF and a HEIC photo a JPEG in converted/, a PDF is skipped, all in one command that waits for nobody.

shell.output:
OK contract.docx -> converted/contract.pdf
OK IMG_2041.heic -> converted/IMG_2041.jpg
SKIP invoice.pdf

call.command: cd "$PANTHEON_PROJECTS"/'drop' && mkdir -p converted && for f in *; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; case "${f##*.}" in docx|odt|DOCX|ODT) [ -e "converted/${f%.*}.pdf" ] && continue; libreoffice --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir converted "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "OK $f -> converted/${f%.*}.pdf" || echo "FAIL $f";; heic|HEIC) [ -e "converted/${f%.*}.jpg" ] && continue; heif-convert "$f" "converted/${f%.*}.jpg" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "OK $f -> converted/${f%.*}.jpg" || echo "FAIL $f";; mov|mkv|MOV|MKV) [ -e "converted/${f%.*}.mp4" ] && continue; ffmpeg -nostdin -loglevel error -i "$f" -c:v libx264 -c:a aac "converted/${f%.*}.mp4" && echo "OK $f -> converted/${f%.*}.mp4" || echo "FAIL $f";; *) echo "SKIP $f";; esac; done

script.say:
**Converted**
- contract.docx → converted/contract.pdf
- IMG_2041.heic → converted/IMG_2041.jpg

**Skipped**
- invoice.pdf — already a PDF

**Failed**
- none

## Report
- 1 command: converted 2 files, skipped 1

## Carry forward
- nothing failing
